injected_env_vars.name: PLANET_NAME
injected_env_vars.description: Planet subdomain name for CORS and routing (e.g., 'scare' for 'scare.scareverse.net')

injected_env_vars.name: PLANET_OWNER_ID
injected_env_vars.description: UUID of this planet's owner. When set, guest users receive only artifacts for which the owner has granted allowance.

injected_env_vars.name: TUNNEL_FQDN
injected_env_vars.description: Fully-qualified domain name of the Cloudflare tunnel subdomain. Used for CORS configuration and building public API URLs.

injected_env_vars.name: VITE_SCARERUNNER_URL
injected_env_vars.description: ScareRunner base URL for frontend (translations, cell types, API). Resolved from settings.vite.scarerunner.url

injected_env_vars.name: CENTRALHUB_SERVICE_TOKEN
injected_env_vars.description: Service-specific JWT token for Backend→CentralHub authentication (MongoDB proxy RBAC)

injected_env_vars.name: PLANET_AUDIENCE
injected_env_vars.description: Expected JWT audience claim value for planet tokens (e.g., 'scare.scareverse.net'). Resolved from settings.planet.audience

injected_env_vars.name: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
injected_env_vars.description: Cloudflare API token for Calls TURN server provisioning

injected_env_vars.name: CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
injected_env_vars.description: Cloudflare Account ID for Calls TURN server provisioning

injected_env_vars.name: CLOUDFLARE_APP_ID
injected_env_vars.description: Cloudflare Calls App ID for WebRTC sessions

injected_env_vars.name: CLOUDFLARE_APP_SECRET
injected_env_vars.description: Cloudflare Calls App Secret (Bearer token) for WebRTC sessions
